# Test files

`gedcom70/` is the specification's `testfiles/gedcom70/*.ged` from
[FamilySearch/GEDCOM.io](https://github.com/FamilySearch/GEDCOM.io), fetched
at the commit pinned in the Taskfile by `task testdata:fetch`. FamilySearch
publishes them for implementers alongside the specification; taken as
Apache 2.0, the specification's licence (`../LICENSE.gedcom`).
